sections.Profile:
Star Trek: The Next Generation , released by Williams in November 1993, is a four-player widebody machine with a dot-matrix display in which the player joins the crew of the USS Enterprise against the Borg and other foes across the final frontier. Designed by Steve Ritchie, it has two ball-firing cannons and a patented ball delivery system under the playfield that keeps spare balls waiting, so a ball that drops into one of its holes sends another straight back into play.
